title: Gradient between two levelled points
statement: Between two points with levels, the gradient is the plan distance (points flattened to 2D) divided by the level difference, shown as 1 in N (N rounded to an integer) and as a percentage to 2 decimals. Equal levels are reported as such.
dependencies: DT:clic_or_type_level (two different definitions: 0 - Function library.lsp and _PersonalLibrary.lsp)

evidence.detail: d12 from flattened points; 1/N and % printed

uncertainty: Points and levels are remembered between runs in the global INT_lastPoints; a run can reuse the previous run's inputs
